_about: Initial settings and guardrails for the demo. Rates are the user's own all-in € per GiB (ingest, retention, queries). They are example values, not a Dynatrace price list.

cost_model._about: all_in uses rates_eur_per_gib. split separates Ingest & Process (€/GiB) from Retain (€/GiB-day × retention days): an OpenPipeline drop saves Retain only, a Collector drop saves both. Example values, not a Dynatrace price list; switching is pending a decision (docs/DISCOVERY.md §4).

guardrails.name: ERROR and FATAL logs
guardrails.reason: Errors are what people debug with. Sift never drops or samples them; fix the code that throws them instead.

guardrails.name: Security and audit logs
guardrails.reason: Audit trails have to stay complete for compliance.

guardrails.name: Data an alert, SLO or workflow read in the last 90 days
guardrails.reason: Dropping it would silence an alert, break an SLO or starve an automation.
